verification.notes: Public company and community profiles identify Ahmed Qureshi as a longtime Navy reservist and document that he was commanding officer of a Navy Reserve support unit in 2016. They do not establish that he currently holds both O-6 rank and a commanding-officer billet. Also, O-6 is a rank grade, not another term for commanding officer. The historical core is supported but the present-tense formulation is not.
